name: qpdf
description: PDF transformation and inspection library with comprehensive manipulation capabilities

qpdf.description: PDF transformation tool with optimization, encryption, and structural manipulation capabilities
qpdf.usage:
qpdf --optimize-images --compress-streams=y input.pdf output.pdf # Optimize and compress PDF
qpdf --linearize input.pdf output.pdf # Linearize PDF for fast web viewing
qpdf --decrypt input.pdf output.pdf # Remove password protection
qpdf --encrypt user owner 256 -- input.pdf output.pdf # Add AES-256 encryption
qpdf --pages file1.pdf 1-5 file2.pdf 10-15 -- output.pdf # Merge specific pages
qpdf --split-pages input.pdf output-%d.pdf # Split into individual pages
qpdf --json input.pdf # Extract PDF structure as JSON
qpdf --show-pages input.pdf # Display page information
qpdf --check input.pdf # Validate PDF structure
qpdf --compression-level=9 --recompress-flate input.pdf output.pdf # Maximum compression

fix-qdf.description: Fix QDF (QPDF Data Format) files by repairing structural issues and inconsistencies
fix-qdf.usage:
fix-qdf input.qdf output.qdf # Repair QDF file structure
fix-qdf --object-streams input.qdf output.qdf # Fix object stream issues

zlib-flate.description: Compress and decompress data using zlib/flate compression algorithms
zlib-flate.usage:
zlib-flate -compress < input.txt > output.flate # Compress data
zlib-flate -uncompress < input.flate > output.txt # Decompress data
echo 'test data' | zlib-flate -compress | zlib-flate -uncompress # Round-trip test
